messages:
maria: Accepted the org invite but when I try to open the repo I get a 403 — 'You don’t have access to this repository'. I already authorized Okta SSO. Anyone seen this?

devon-iam: Welcome! Two quick checks: did you accept the invite using the same GitHub account tied to Okta, and is your work email primary on your GH account?

maria: I accepted with my personal GH account but I added my work email as a secondary. Okta shows me as authorized though.

devon-iam: Try signing out and then sign in via the SSO link from your invite email (or go to https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso). Incognito helps rule out cached sessions.

onboard-bot: Reminder: Organization SSO + org membership is required for private repo access. If you're listed as an outside collaborator you'll still get limited access. Docs: https://redwood.link/sso-help

maria: Tried incognito, still 403. On the org page my membership shows as 'Pending' next to the invite?

samir-eng: Thanks for the ping — I'm looking. Looks like the invite accepted you as an outside collaborator on one repo instead of as an org member. I changed your membership to org member and added you to the platform-engineering team. Give GitHub a couple minutes to propagate.

maria: Reloaded and I can see the repo now, yay. Thanks! How do I get access to the other platform repos?

olivia-pe: Hi maria — I can add you to the rest after confirming 2FA and primary email. Can you confirm you have 2FA enabled and that your work email is the primary email on your GitHub account?

maria: 2FA is on via an authenticator app. Switching my work email to primary now.

samir-eng: Once you switch the primary and re-authorize SSO (if prompted), I'll add the remaining platform repos and teams. If anything still errors, DM me and I'll escalate.

maria: All good now — can clone and push. Thanks everyone! :tada:
